stimulus:
Welcome to the experiment!

Press any key to begin

Instructions

In this experiment, you will see 2 images of real world objects on each trial.
Your task is to determine which image appears larger or smaller on the screen.
Please respond as quickly and accurately as possible.

You will be asked to complete 2 blocks of trials:
1. Larger image block (select the image that appears larger)
2. Smaller image block (select the image that appears smaller)

Each block will contain practice trials with feedback, followed by actual trials without feedback.
Each trial will begin with a fixation cross (+), followed by the images, and feedback if applicable.

To respond, you will press z to choose the left image, and m to choose the right image.
Before starting, place your left index finger on z and right index finger on m.

Press any key to begin.

Now you will complete the practice trial.


You will complete one practice trial and receive feedback.
If your response is incorrect, you would repeat the trial until correct.

Instruction on which size to pick will appear on the next screen.
Press z to choose the left image, and m to choose the right image.

Press any key to continue.

Which is visually smaller on the screen?


Press z to choose the left image, and m to choose the right image.
Press any key to continue.

Now you will begin the actual trials.

Press any key to continue.

Which is visually smaller on the screen?


Press z to choose the left image, and m to choose the right image.
Press any key to continue.
